title: Framing-Induced Vulnerability in Large Language Models: Evidence from Chinese News Headlines
abstract: arXiv:2611.13531v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models increasingly evaluate, route, and moderate news, so a model's judgment of a headline has become a gatekeeping decision. We ask whether that judgment follows the fact being reported or the way the fact is framed. We combine an ecological audit of 63,926 Chinese news headlines with a controlled experiment. The experiment covers 30 real events, 30 synthetic events, and 29 natural headline pairs, tested on four Chinese models. Changing only the headline frame shifted both perceived misleadingness and event severity, and the direction and ordering of the shifts were the same for DeepSeek, MiMo, Dots, and LongCat. Emotionally intensified headlines raised severity ratings by 0.65 to 0.88 points, whereas positively reframed headlines lowered them by 0.34 to 0.52 points. Supplying the article body reduced this severity bias by 54 to 80 percent, and all four reductions were significant at p < .01. A small human reference stud

translated_title: 大语言模型中的框架诱导脆弱性：来自中文新闻标题的证据
translated_abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地承担评估、路由和审核新闻的任务，因此模型对一条新闻标题的判断已成为一种“守门人”决策。我们探究这种判断究竟是依据所报道的事实本身，还是依据事实被呈现的框架方式。我们将对63,926条中文新闻标题的生态学审计与一项受控实验相结合。实验涵盖30个真实事件、30个合成事件和29对自然标题，并在四个中文模型上进行了测试。仅改变标题的框架就会改变模型感知到的误导性和事件严重程度，且变化的方向和排序在DeepSeek、MiMo、Dots和LongCat四个模型上保持一致。情绪强化型标题使严重程度评分提高了0.65至0.88分，而正面重构型标题使其降低了0.34至0.52分。提供文章正文可使这种严重性偏差降低54%至80%，且四项降低均在p < .01水平上显著。一项小型人类参照研究……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该研究通过6万多条中文新闻标题审计和跨四个中文模型的受控实验，首次系统揭示了大型语言模型对新闻标题的判断主要受标题框架而非事实本身的影响——情绪化框架会显著抬高事件严重性评分，而提供完整文章正文可降低54%至80%的此类偏差。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that large language models' judgments of Chinese news headlines are systematically vulnerable to framing effects rather than the underlying facts—emotionally intensified frames inflate severity ratings across four models, while providing full article context reduces this bias by 54–80%.
